Acme API Changelog

October 1, 2026

Breaking: the listPets endpoint now requires a tenant query parameter. Requests without it return HTTP 400 starting November 1, 2026.

The legacyExport endpoint has been removed. Use the new bulk export job instead.

September 15, 2026

Added the uploadPhoto endpoint so you can attach images to a pet. It accepts multipart form data and returns the stored photo id.

The listPets endpoint now supports a page query parameter for cursor-free pagination through large collections.

August 1, 2026

We improved rate limit headers: every response now carries X-RateLimit-Remaining alongside the existing X-RateLimit-Limit header for easier client side throttling.

  • Fixed a bug where weight_kg was returned as an integer for some legacy records.
  • Documentation for the owners resource was expanded with more examples.
